observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher guides students through traditional Ekitaguriro steps with enthusiastic encouragement and high energy. She breaks down movements step-by-step and practices them alongside the music.

lesson_structure.note: Welcomes viewers and introduces the Ekitaguriro dance for beginners.
Warming up bodies and shaking out arms.
Counts and demonstrates horn hand movements and side-to-side steps.
Practicing the routine with background music.
Explaining and demonstrating the final climactic steps.

metaphors: The beautiful horns of a cow

steps_taught.name: Cow Horns arm and foot movement
steps_taught.description: Swaying side to side while moving arms to represent cow horns.

what_works: Demonstrating from multiple angles including side and back views
what_hinders: Frequent angle changes and fast camera cuts

quotes.text: Welcome everyone today is going to be so much fun
because we are learning the amazing ekitaguriro dance
You gonna sway with me from side to side and feel the rhythm

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher stands facing the camera in a room, greeting the audience and introducing the dance.
evidence_segments.cannot_infer: exact foot placement details due to wide framing

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher performs stepping in place while moving arms upward and outward.
Teacher turns sideways and demonstrates a lower body squatting motion.
evidence_segments.cannot_infer: joint strain or exact muscular engagement

extraction.distinctive_method: Using a rolled-up green cloth tied around the waist to emphasize hip and lower body posture during traditional cattle-inspired movements.
